senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חוּט III)to draw, stretch. Part. pass. שָׁחוּט.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:4:5">Y. Yoma IV, 41ᵈ</cite> top (expl. <he>זהב שׁחוט</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 10:17">I Kings X, 17</cite>) <he>שהיה משוך כשעוה</he> it was drawn out like wax; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:10">Cant. R. to III, 10</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 45a:1">Yoma 45ᵃ</cite> <he>שנטוה כחוט</he> it was spun like a thread; <cite ref="Chullin 30b:2">Ḥull. 30ᵇ</cite>.

Ib. (to prove that in slaughtering you must draw the knife over the animal’s throat and not chop) אין ושחט אלא ומשך וכ׳ v’shaḥaṭ (Lev. I, 5) means and ‘he shall draw’, and so it says zahab shaḥuṭ (v. supra) and also ḥets shaḥuṭ (Jer. IX, 7; Keri שוחט).
